g.text: Two Stores, Two Different Shard Keys
Postings are looked up by TERM; metadata is looked up by DOC_ID -- each sharded to match its own query
Inverted index postings -- sharded by TERM hash
one posting LIST per term; scanned per matching document
looked up ONCE per result shown, not per match
Copying the postings' shard key onto metadata (or vice versa) would optimize for a query pattern neither table actually has --
each store's shard key matches its own dominant lookup, the same reasoning this guide's sharding page applies generally.
